evals.name: check-reports-effective-config-read-only
evals.expected_output: Defaults to the check action: reads every accessible layer of the .claude/improvement.md cascade (user-global, team, local overlay), reports which layers exist and the effective merged configuration (churn window, exclusion patterns, Tier 2 evidence_sources entries) with per-layer provenance, and modifies nothing. All layers absent is reported as INFO (bundled defaults; Tier 2 is an evidence gap), never as a failure. It does not run an improvement scan.
expectations: No argument routes to the read-only check action — does NOT error or start writing config
Reads all three cascade layers it can access and reports which layer supplies each effective value
Treats a repo with no config in any layer as INFO (valid zero-config state), not FAIL
Modifies no files and does not run /improvement:find's scan

evals.name: apply-interviews-and-writes-team-file-only
evals.expected_output: Runs the check first, presents the effective merged baseline across layers, drafts defaults from the repo (churn exclusions from generated/build trees, evidence-source candidates from configured MCP servers), then interviews the user one decision at a time before writing. Writes only the team .claude/improvement.md in the reference/config.md file format, never a vendor-specific source the user did not declare, and never the user-global layer or the .local.md overlay.
expectations: Reads the effective config across all layers and presents it before proposing changes
Drafts churn-exclusion and evidence-source candidates from the repo and configured MCP servers before asking
Interviews with recommendations rather than writing blind; nothing dropped without confirmation
Writes only the team .claude/improvement.md — never the user-global file or the .local.md overlay
Does not invent or hardcode a vendor-specific telemetry source the user did not declare

evals.name: verifies-tracked-and-offers-overlay-convention
evals.prompt:
/improvement:setup apply

Just write a sensible config for this repo — churn defaults are fine, no telemetry sources yet.
evals.expected_output: Writes the team .claude/improvement.md with only the confirmed churn keys, states that Tier 2 stays a declared evidence gap, re-runs BOTH check probes (git check-ignore for not-ignored AND git ls-files --error-unmatch for tracked — flagging the written-but-untracked state as 'commit it', never success), and offers the recursive .claude/**/*.local.* gitignore line for the personal overlay without editing the consumer's .gitignore itself.
expectations: Accepts 'no telemetry sources' as a valid outcome — writes churn keys only and says Tier 2 remains an evidence gap
Verifies the written team file with both probes: not gitignored (git check-ignore) AND actually tracked (git ls-files --error-unmatch), flagging untracked as commit-needed rather than success
Recommends the recursive .claude/**/*.local.* gitignore line for the overlay
Does not edit the consumer's .gitignore or write into the plugin/plugin-data directories
